business.what_it_does: Provides financing services for pre-owned commercial vehicles, two-wheelers, MSMEs, gold loans, and personal loans.
business.mix_note: No single external customer contributes 10% or more to revenues.
risks_mgmt_flags: Portfolio remains predominantly focused on the pre-owned commercial vehicle segment.
Loan book linked to commercial vehicles which move with freight activity and infrastructure cycles.
Operates with a higher cost of funds than banks as an NBFC.

credibility.line: Management frequently adjusts growth targets and missed initial 18-20% growth goals before lowering expectations to 15-17%.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management guided for 18%-20% growth in Q3 FY26 (g1.1), but Q4 FY26 revenue growth slowed down to 9.2%.
PAT growth remained strong, with Q2 FY27 PAT growing 59.37% year-on-year to INR3,677.03 crores alongside 16.96% AUM growth.
Operating cash flow remains heavily negative at -13,281.0 crores in Mar 2026 despite rising reported net profit.

bull: PAT grew 59.37% year-on-year to INR3,677.03 crores in Q2 FY27.
AUM reached 3,29,021.72 crores in Q2 FY27, representing a 16.96% year-on-year increase.
Equity expanded to 1,11,435.0 crores as of Sep 2026, lowering D/E to 2.12.
bear: Operating cash flow remains profoundly negative at -13,281.0 crores for Mar 2026.
Management walked back its 18% AUM growth budget in Q2 FY27 to a lower 15%-17% range.
Revenue growth decelerated to 9.2% in Mar 2026 compared to 20.8% in Mar 2025.
watch: Whether AUM growth stays within the revised 15% to 17% annual guidance.
Trajectory of negative operating cash flow relative to reported profits.
Stage 2 and Stage 3 asset quality trends.
